methodology.provenance: Reused existing export_tpch.py timings; no new benchmark executions. Every saved SQL equals the current authored catalog SQL byte-for-byte; all six CLI log wall times match JSON warmup plus five measured samples.
methodology.timed_scope: DuckDB CLI .timer real wall time for the complete authored SELECT, not a COUNT wrapper; execution consumes and renders all result rows in CSV mode to the per-query log. Result retrieval/output is included, rather than execution-only operator timing.
methodology.loading_excluded: Database generation, binary export, process startup/database opening and SET threads occur outside the timed SELECT. Database scan/decompression and any reads needed by the SELECT remain inside its timing. A prior warmup runs the same SELECT in the same process; this is not a cold-cache test.

runs.process_scope: one CLI process per query and thread count

methodology.aggregation: median of five measured runs, excluding warmup
methodology.sql_semantics: Authored retail workload SQL, including DISTINCT and grouped folds where specified; these are not automatically the official TPC-H queries.
methodology.limitations: Historical timings reused; exporter does not record capture time or concurrent host activity. Current hardware snapshot does not prove historical load/isolation.

raw_timing.query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, c.c_custkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:

    s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment
FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey

    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2
    JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey AND r2.r_name = 'EUROPE')
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:
SELECT c_custkey, c_name,
    CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue,
    CAST(c_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT) AS account_balance, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey,
    c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate,
    l.l_linenumber, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, n.n_name
    FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_returnflag = 'R') AS matches
GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY')
SELECT ps_partkey, CAST(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 100 AS BIGINT)
FROM matches GROUP BY ps_partkey
HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) >
    (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001 FROM matches)
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:
SELECT l_shipmode,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS high_line_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS low_line_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_shipmode, l.l_commitdate,
    l.l_receiptdate, l.l_shipdate, o.o_orderpriority
    FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP') AND l.l_commitdate < l.l_receiptdate
      AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate AND l.l_receiptdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_receiptdate < DATE '1995-01-01') AS matches
GROUP BY l_shipmode
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN
        l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS promo_revenue,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount)), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_partkey,
    l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipdate, p.p_type
    FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-09-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-10-01') AS matches
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:
WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_key,
        CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_suppkey,
        l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01') matches
    GROUP BY l_suppkey)
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, r.total_revenue
FROM supplier s JOIN revenue r ON s.s_suppkey = r.supplier_key
WHERE r.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue)
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

raw_timing.query:

    SELECT l_orderkey, CAST(SUM(l_quantity) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_quantity
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity FROM lineitem) AS lines
    GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300.00
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey,
    (o.o_orderdate - DATE '1970-01-01')::INTEGER AS o_orderdate,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice * 100 AS BIGINT) AS total_price, q.sum_quantity

raw_timing.query:
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1.00 - l_discount)), 0) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey, l.l_linenumber, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipmode, l.l_shipinstruct,
    p.p_brand, p.p_container, p.p_size
    FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
    AND ((p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 1.00 AND 11.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 10.00 AND 20.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
        OR (p.p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
            AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 20.00 AND 30.00 AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15))) AS matches
raw_timing.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count

            FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
                AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01') l
        WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey))
